# relay_organization (Data Source)

Reads an organization the token's user belongs to. Without `id` or `slug` it reads the provider's `org_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_organization" "current" {}

data "relay_organization" "by_slug" {
  slug = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Organization ID.
- `slug` (String) Organization slug.

### Read-Only

- `audit_retention_days` (Number) Audit log retention. 0 keeps logs forever.
- `cli_token_ttl_hours` (Number) CLI login lifetime, in hours.
- `locale` (String) Default locale.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `session_absolute_max_hours` (Number) Dashboard absolute session cap. 0 uses the default.
- `session_idle_timeout_minutes` (Number) Dashboard idle timeout. 0 uses the default.
- `session_length_hours` (Number) Dashboard session length, in hours.
- `timezone` (String) Default timezone.
